format.raw: exact original UTF-16 localStorage string or null; nested STRING, never stringify parsed configurations
format.nullMeaning: original absent storage key / empty collection. Existing empty JSON string envelope remains distinct.
format.validation: Feed raw to new SavedLooks with isolated getItem adapter; existing metadata authority validates names/IDs/count/version; unsupported configs preserved. Current invalid or inaccessible store blocks backup/preview/restore, no corruption repair.

transactions.preview: decode file text/envelope + validate raw; read valid current real snapshot only after successful file read. Preview lists incoming names/count and replacement of existing count. No write on load/selection/preview.
transactions.restore: Separate human click; re-read full current raw immediately before one setItem or removeItem. Refuse mismatch/error. Exact incoming raw=before raw is no-op retaining Undo. Publish new before/after Undo only after successful actual changed write. No apply/reopen active avatar.
transactions.undo: One human button; require current raw===last applied raw; write exact previous string or restore absent-key with removeItem. Clear only after success; refuse stale/read/write without overwriting. Invalid current envelope stops.
transactions.concurrency: Existing best-effort read-compare-write; no locking/CAS/guaranteed multiwindow serialization. storage event invalidates stale previews/Undo and refreshes visible list; commit also rechecks.
transactions.unsupported: Metadata retains existing unavailable configurations; safe text-only names, no option normalization/new store/profile/migration/merge.

lifetime.reads: Input File.size cap before await, file.text result string cap after. Generation/disposed checks after await; UI busy prevents overlapping user submissions; Cancel/pagehide invalidate pending reads. No uncancellable File.text or filepicker hard cancellation claim.
lifetime.downloads: JSON Blob exact encoded STRING envelope, owned objectURL/anchor/timer. Remove anchor; revoke after1second or immediately on synchronous error/pagehide; record callback guards.
lifetime.page: Named listeners dispose on pagehide; all URLs/timers retired, pending preview/Undo discarded. pageshow persisted reloads fresh standalone page instead of reviving old snapshots; that one documented listener is retained as explicit BFCache owner. No renderer/GPU started.
lifetime.focus: Native file input, separate Preview outcome, explicit Restore/Cancel/Undo reachable. Live status/error text; names textContent; after Restore/Undo refresh current list and predictable focus.
